subject: Request: DPIA artifacts & Art.28/30 evidence for Bridgewell onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@bridgewell.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Bridgewell Legal <legal@bridgewell.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 14:17:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA artifacts & Art.28/30 evidence request for onboarding

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our vendor onboarding / DPIA scoping we need to gather a small evidence package to satisfy our privacy team and internal auditors. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following items for our security/privacy review?

- A short extract of the Art.30 processing activities register that covers processing of Bridgewell customer data (fields, purpose, lawful basis).
- Subprocessor inventory with dates of engagement and processing locations.
- A sample of operational logs showing export/transfers related to a single test job (redacted identifiers is fine).
- Any existing DPIA support notes or a checklist you typically share with customers (clarity on roles/data flows).

We're in the EU and will need this by end of next week to stay on the onboarding timeline — do you see any blockers? If parts of these documents require a data transfer addendum or additional non-disclosure, let us know and we can route to procurement.

Appreciate a quick read on feasibility and an ETA.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Bridgewell Systems

From: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bridgewell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & Art.28/30 evidence request for onboarding

Thanks Elena — welcome, and glad the walkthrough helped. Short answer: yes, we can put together an evidence package to cover Art.28/30 and DPIA support items. Outline below and ETA.

What we can provide this week / next week:
- Art.30 register excerpt (CSV) scoped to Bridgewell: fields, processing purpose, controller/processor roles, legal basis (we will redact any third-party tenant IDs).
- Subprocessor inventory (PDF) with onboarding dates and primary processing regions; we will flag any subprocessors that involve cross-border flows and note safeguards.
- Operational sample (redacted) logs for a single test job: timestamped event trace for request receipt, token generation events, and transfer/egress events.
- DPIA support checklist (XLSX): typical questions we map to controls, and a suggested section for your DPIA.

Open questions for scope / redaction:
1) For the Art.30 extract, do you prefer column-level redaction (token-level IDs) or a summarized row format (we typically provide both but only one for initial handover).
2) For logs: is a single test job sufficient, or does your team want multiple samples across regions?
3) Any specific subprocessors you want highlighted (e.g., KMS, telemetry, logging) so we can include additional notes?

ETA: provisional package ready by Friday 2028-04-14 COB (UTC) if scope is limited to a single job sample and summarized Art.30 rows; if you want full column-level export we will need until Tue 2028-04-18 to complete the additional redaction pass.

I[0m
Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: bridgewell_dpia_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB) — DPIA support checklist]

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bridgewell.com>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & Art.28/30 evidence request for onboarding

Hi Elena — looping in with the Art.30 excerpt and subprocessor inventory. See links and brief notes below.

- Art.30 excerpt: linked CSV attached (art30-register-excerpt.csv). This is a summarized extract for onboarding: one row per processing activity with columns for "activity_id", "data_categories", "purpose", "roles", "lawful_basis", "locations". We removed tenant-specific identifiers per Soojin's note.
- Subprocessor inventory: attached PDF (subprocessor-inventory.pdf) with engagement dates and primary processing region. For any subprocessors that store keys or handle telemetry, we flagged them in the "notes" column.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjKlmno (folder: Bridgewell_onboarding_evidence) — artifacts are in the folder; access granted to elena@bridgewell.com.

Karthik, quick confirm on logs: we prepared a redacted operational sequence for a single test job (no PII, job id hashed). If Bridgewell wants cross-region samples we can run one additional job from our EU cluster and include that trace.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: art30-register-excerpt.csv (CSV, 14KB); subprocessor-inventory.pdf (PDF, 47KB)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@bridgewell.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 18:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & Art.28/30 evidence request for onboarding

Hi Marissa / Soojin — this is excellent, thank you both. We were able to review the folder and the artifacts look to cover our initial checklist. A couple of quick follow-ups for the audit team:

- Could you include a short covering note that states which items have been redacted and why (we'll attach that to our DPIA)?
- For the subprocessor inventory, can you confirm whether any subprocessors perform transfers to the US and, if so, what safeguards are in place (SCCs, encryption-at-rest, limited access)? A single-paragraph summary would be perfect.

Otherwise we should be fine to proceed to internal sign-off — we'll confirm by Tue 2028-04-17. If you can add the covering note and the subprocessor transfer summary by Monday morning CET, that would keep our timeline intact.

Thanks again — will loop procurement if any addendums are required.

Best,
Elena
